mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT status_login FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT refresh_token FROM oauth_access_token WHERE user_name = #{username} AND client_id = #{clientId} LIMIT 1;

SELECT access_token AS accessToken, token_type AS tokenType, refresh_token AS refreshToken, expires_in AS expiresIn, scope AS scope FROM access_token WHERE is_active = 1 AND username = #{filter.searchText} LIMIT 1;
UPDATE access_token SET login_status = 1 WHERE is_active = 1 AND username = #{username};
mapper.update: UPDATE access_token SET username = #{accessTokenRequest.username}, access_token = #{accessTokenRequest.accessToken}, token_type = #{accessTokenRequest.tokenType}, refresh_token = #{accessTokenRequest.refreshToken}, expires_in = #{accessTokenRequest.expiresIn}, scope = #{accessTokenRequest.scope}, login_verify_token = #{accessTokenRequest.loginVerifyToken} WHERE username = #{accessTokenRequest.username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO access_token ( username, login_verify_token, access_token, token_type, refresh_token, expires_in, scope, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{accessTokenRequest.username}, #{accessTokenRequest.loginVerifyToken}, #{accessTokenRequest.accessToken}, #{accessTokenRequest.tokenType}, #{accessTokenRequest.refreshToken}, #{accessTokenRequest.expiresIn}, #{accessTokenRequest.scope}, NOW(), #{accessTokenRequest.createdBy}, 1 );
